name: Box
dimensions: Height 34.5 cm; Width 17.5 cm; Depth 8.8 cm
summary: The Chinese empire during the Qing dynasty (1644-1901) included the regions of modern Tibet and Mongolia, and the patronage of the Buddhists of these regions was important to the state. The iconography of the type of Buddhism practised in these areas, called Lamaism, also deeply influenced court art
